bout.identity_discriminator: GEMINI'S IDENTITY STATEMENT IS WRONG AND WAS OVERTURNED. It says 'Keven Julio is the blonde competitor wearing blue ankle bands', derived from the lower-third graphic's blue bar -- the one inference the sheet's own instructions forbid, because that bar is left/right design (the same broadcast puts Bruno on the blue side in video 15546999 and on the red side here). Correct mapping, from the bodies: Bruno Fernandes Rocha = ROYAL-BLUE rashguard, black shorts, CYAN tape on the LEFT ankle, right-shin tattoo -- the same man, kit for kit, whose arm is raised as the winner of video 15546999 (same event, same day), and Bruno is the only athlete common to both videos. Keven Julio = the LIGHTER sky-blue rashguard, black shorts, GREEN band on the right ankle, dark hair, tattooed left arm. The referee raises the LIGHT-blue athlete's arm at t=183-186 -> Keven Julio won, which is also the published result. Every actor below was therefore re-derived from the frames, not taken from the reading: Gemini's own actor names turn out to be swapped on the mid-bout control events and right on the finish, so no blanket inversion was applied.
